Field Log

What actually happened

Four entries, in order, no polish removed.

LOG 01

Built the pipeline

Three parts: SIFT-based ML visualization, an OpenCV AR line overlay, and a full footage → point-cloud reconstruction pipeline (COLMAP + ffmpeg).

LOG 02

Tested on the real site

Ran all three against 15 actual Rohtas Fort photographs — Sohail Gate, Kabuli Gate, Shishi Gate, and more. No placeholders.

LOG 03

Found the real constraint

Single tourist-style shots of different gates don't share the overlap Structure-from-Motion needs. Proven with real match data — 2 of 15 connected.

LOG 04

Proved the pipeline works

Same code, run on a real 11-photo multi-view set (Château de Sceaux) — 8,048 triangulated points, shown above.

Result 01 — ML Visualization

What the model actually sees

SIFT keypoint detection on Sohail Gate — the same features a reconstruction pipeline relies on to understand a photo. Drag to compare.

Raw photo
SIFT keypoints
1,848keypoints detected

Density clusters exactly on the carved arch detail and stonework joints — the model is reading real architecture, not background noise.

Result 02 — AR Line Overlay

Structure, highlighted live

Canny edge detection + Hough transform on the wide fort panorama — the same detect-and-draw step an AR pass would run per camera frame. Drag to compare.

Raw photo
Line overlay
233structural lines detected

Arches, parapet crenellations, and wall courses all pick up cleanly — the vegetation-heavy foreground stays comparatively quiet.
